title: What 300 Starlink dishes did for kids in Argentina's most remote villages
title_candidates: Starlink just connected every rural school in an entire province
What 300 Starlink dishes did for kids in Argentina's most remote villages
The moment every school in Neuquén got internet for the very first time
How a satellite company solved the internet problem one province couldn't crack
300 Starlink antennas just reached the schools cables and towers never could
caption:
Every rural school in Neuquén, Argentina is now online, thanks to around 300 Starlink antennas installed since 2024. The provincial program, Plan Pehuén, just hit 100% coverage, including schools deep in mountain valleys that had never had a reliable connection.

Starlink satellites orbit far closer to Earth than old-school satellites, so they reach places where cables and cell towers simply don't go. Neuquén is now one of the first provinces anywhere to close the digital gap in every single school using satellite internet at this scale.
